title: Ebony Hustle 2: Ballistic Protection
description: Local detective and icon Ebony Hustle returns and hopes to grow into her new life. She starts a romance with Marc, and up-and-coming basketball player, with a secret to hide, when she then encounters and old rival who hasn't let go of the past.

title: Hidden Agenda
description: Bright and gifted Jessica takes on a side hustle tutoring popular football star, Ryan. After the football team wins the championship game, Ryan decides to throw an after party at his house. When Ryan is found dead, multiple people are suspects.

title: The Bayou City Murders
description: Houston police officer Tamara Haynes takes a bold interest in recent murders of women in Houston's South Side, believing there is likely a serial killer on the loose.

title: Finding Boaz
description: After a failed engagement, Torrey is afraid of becoming a lonely spinster. Torrey solicits the help of her cousin Nell, who enrolls her in a "How to Catch a Man" school. Torrey catches far more than she bargained for.

title: Then There Was You
description: Lady's man Kingston gets more than he bargains for when he encounters Shandre, a spoken-word artist who introduces him to a lifestyle deeply rooted in African American culture.

title: The Price of Fame
description: Cassie, a young woman searching for purpose, meets Ryan, who offers her a chance to step into the world of fame and opportunity. With guidance from her best friend, Ledrick, Cassie navigates the glamorous yet cutthroat entertainment industry.

title: ToxiCity
description: Corey Spencer, the innovator behind the successful ATLUV dating app, navigates a complex personal life. Despite his app's mission, he struggles with love, further complicated by a child support order.

title: Three of a Kind
description: Three years after graduation, college friends Hope, Chanta and May eagerly reunite for Hope's wedding to her fiancé, Robert. As the weekend unfolds, a secret emerges. When the truth comes to light, the celebration descends into chaos.

title: Trouble
description: As Draven faces financial ruin and a serious illness, her marriage to Adam frays. She reconnects with Cecelius, a wealthy ex, finding comfort in his stability. But as their romance blossoms, Adam's jealousy spirals into something dangerous.

title: Something Old
description: Days from her wedding, Kara meets her ex, Malik, for one last goodbye. But Malik wants her back and won't take no for an answer, turning a hotel meetup into a dangerous game of obsession. Can Jordan uncover the truth before time runs out?

description: Xavier and his wife Amanda, take their daughter on a road trip hoping for a family reset. After a pit stop, Amanda and Alexandria disappear, and everyone is convinced he came to the park alone.

description: An arrogant, disrespectful, mischievous teenager is up to no good when he hears the voice of God, who instructs him to change his ways.

description: Following the death of her district attorney husband, Nivea McKenzie sets out to find the person responsible. By digging into his past, Nivea discovers that she knew nothing about the man she married.
